scripts.start: concurrently "yarn workspace @open-data/main-client start" "yarn workspace @open-data/dashboard-client start" "yarn workspace @open-data/dashboard-service start" "yarn workspace @open-data/national-bank-client start" "yarn workspace @open-data/national-bank-service start"
scripts.start:dev: concurrently "yarn workspace @open-data/main-client start:dev" "yarn workspace @open-data/dashboard-client start:dev" "yarn workspace @open-data/dashboard-service start:dev" "yarn workspace @open-data/national-bank-client start:dev" "yarn workspace @open-data/national-bank-service start:dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @open-data/shared-ui-lib run build && yarn workspaces run build
scripts.clean:all: yarn workspaces run clean && yarn clean
